title: Specified cyber incidents reported to CERT-In within six hours of noticing
framework_version: Directions dated 28 April 2022 under s.70B(6), Information Technology Act, 2000
notes: The six-hour window is the sharpest India obligation in KYE's scope because it is a hard deadline on an incident lifecycle. KYE timestamps and seals each governed step (detect -> triage -> contain -> evidence -> notify) so the elapsed time against the clock is provable rather than asserted. KYE does NOT detect the incident and does NOT file the report.
